Freedom gave us the space to dream.
 Happy 80th Independence Day 🇮🇳
 Live Easy. Live Roomhy.

🇮🇳 Freedom gave us the space to dream.
 
 This Independence Day, we celebrate a free India where every dream has the freedom to grow, every journey has a new beginning, and everyone deserves a place they can call home.
 
 Happy 80th Independence Day! 🇮🇳
 
 Live Easy. Live Roomhy.
Keep text minimal; use the existing Roomhy visual language.
What makes a room feel like home?
Start with an empty room; show bed, desk, window and coffee; transition to friends laughing, eating and talking; end with Roomhy logo.

Is it the room?
 Or is it the people?
 A room becomes home when life happens there.
A room gives you a place to stay. The people, memories and moments make it home. 💚
Use warm lifestyle footage and quick transitions.
5 things to check before choosing a PG
6–7 slides: Location, Total Cost, Safety, Cleanliness, Rules & Amenities, then Roomhy closing slide.

Looking for a PG?
 Check these 5 things first.

Don't choose a PG just because the photos look good. 👀
 
 Before you book, check the location, total cost, safety, cleanliness and amenities.
 
 Your stay matters. Choose wisely.
Use numbered cards with one key point per slide.
Split-screen expectation vs reality. Examples: quiet roommate vs one-more-episode; clean room vs mystery socks. End with friendship message.

Expectation: Quiet roommate 🤫
 Reality: Bro, one more episode?
 
 Some roommates become friends. Some become family.

You don't choose all your roommate stories. 😂
 
 But the best ones become memories you'll never forget.
 
 Tag your roommate. 👇
Use humorous typography and relatable visuals.
First day in a new city
Young person arrives with luggage; city arrival; searching for a place; entering stay; meeting roommates; relaxing.

POV: You just moved to a new city.
 New city. New room. New chapter.

Every new city begins with one small step.
 
 Sometimes, it's finding a room. Sometimes, it's finding your people.
 
 Here's to new beginnings. 💚
Use emotional music and cinematic city shots.
Slides explaining PG, Hostel and Co-living; final slide: Your lifestyle. Your choice. Find your stay with Roomhy.

PG vs Hostel vs Co-living
 Which one is right for you?

One size doesn't fit everyone.
 
 Your ideal stay depends on your budget, lifestyle, location and priorities.
 
 Which one would you choose? PG / Hostel / Co-living?
Keep comparisons simple and visually clean.
Beautiful cozy Roomhy room, warm sunlight, plants and minimal typography.

A room is just four walls.
 Friends make it feel like home. 💚

A room is just four walls.
 
 But inside those four walls can be your first friendship, your late-night conversations, your weekend plans and some of your best memories. 💚
 
 Roomhy isn't just helping you find a room. We're helping you find a place to live your story.

Things you learn after moving out
Text-based reel: laundry, food, rent, cleaning, adulting; finish with Roomhy.

Things you suddenly learn after moving out:
 Laundry doesn't do itself. 😭
 Food isn't magically available.
 Rent comes every month.
 Cleaning is actually a thing.
 Your mom was right. 😂

Nobody really prepares you for the moment you become responsible for your own room. 😂
 
 Welcome to adulthood.

Indian living space with Onam pookalam, traditional food and friends/roommates together; Roomhy branding.

Wherever you live,
 make it feel like home.
 
 Happy Onam 🌼

Home isn't always the place you grew up in.
 
 Sometimes, it's the place where new memories begin. 🌼💚
 
 Wishing everyone a beautiful Onam filled with happiness, togetherness and new beginnings.
 
 Happy Onam!

 Your location is MORE important.

A beautiful room in the wrong location can quickly become a bad decision.
 
 Before you move in, explore the neighbourhood—not just the room.
